symptom: `warning: skipping com.mendix.widget.web.PopupMenu.mpk: package.xml: zip: checksum error` for a package that `unzip -t`, .NET ZipFile and Studio Pro all read; the widget gets no generated definition
cause: archive/zip, for an entry with general-purpose flag bit 3, also requires the data descriptor CRC to equal the central directory CRC (and reads the next record signature as the CRC when the flagged descriptor is absent). unzip/.NET check only the content against the central directory, so a package whose descriptor is missing or disagrees is valid to every tool but Go
file: `internal/zipentry/zipentry.go` (`Open`), used by every zip read in `sdk/widgets/mpk`, `modelsdk/widgets/mpk`, `cmd/mxcli/marketplace`, `cmd/mxcli/docker/build.go`
insight: "Valid to unzip -t, rejected by Go with ErrChecksum" points at the data descriptor, not the content: unzip -t verifies the content CRC, so a real corruption would fail there too. Studio Pro 11.12.4 (`mxcli new`) ships the platform widgets rewritten by .NET with bit 3 on every entry, unlike the GitHub release mpks (bit 3 off) - so testing against a downloaded release cannot reproduce it. Reproduce by zeroing the 4 bytes after a PK\x07\x08 signature; fix by OpenRaw + flate + CRC/size check against the central directory, which keeps real corruption detected (control test flips a stored content byte)
